info.title: Stem Robo Hub API
info.description:
Backend API for the Stem Robo Hub storefront.

**Auth:** call `POST /auth/otp/send` then `POST /auth/otp/verify`, then send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on routes marked with a lock.

**Errors:** non-2xx responses return `{"message": str, "errors": {field: [str]}}`.

get.description: 200 when the API and database are reachable; otherwise 503 with the failing checks.

503.description: A dependency is unavailable; `error.errors` names the failing checks.

post.description:
The order is built from the cart lines listed in `cartItems` (live lines of the cart named by `cartId`); quantities and prices come from the server. Lines not listed stay in the cart.

- `cod`: allowed only for exactly one line with quantity 1; creates the order now (**201**, `order`).
- `online`: no order yet. Stock is held, a Razorpay payment link is created and its URL is returned (**200**, `redirectUrl`). The order is created when the payment succeeds; poll `GET /payments/{reference}` from the return page. **503** when online payments are not configured.
post.summary: Place an order (COD) or start an online payment
